desc: Fifty years ago, the 90 Series was born, pioneering a legacy that would shape military, law enforcement, and civilian sidearms for generations. To celebrate 50 years of the legendary 90 Series, Beretta releases the 92SB Repro. A faithful, limited-edition reproduction of the third model in the iconic lineup. Designed for collectors and enthusiasts who appreciate heritage, this modern classic features a polished anodized frame, polished blued slide and barrel, rounded trigger guard, and flat dust cover, along with all-metal components and upgraded internals like the short reset trigger bar and D hammer spring. Finished with G10 grips, each pistol comes in special collector's packaging and a history booklet chronicling the 90 Series legacy. Only 1,526 units will be produced.
